responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s modeling of C varargs and stdarg builtins before GCC’s target-dependent va_arg lowering. This file defines known-function handlers for va_start, va_copy, va_arg, and va_end, represents active va_list state via an analyzer state machine on a stack-allocated implementation region so stale-frame and missing-va_end problems can be detected, materializes per-call var_arg_region slots in callee frames to carry variadic arguments interprocedurally, checks va_arg type compatibility and exhaustion, and updates the region model as each argument is consumed.
